failure_mode: A recovery PR cannot safely generate an official production baseline when production credentials would be exposed to PR-controlled workflow code.
structural_fix: Generate the official Supabase CLI baseline from trusted default-branch workflow code; for the exact candidate-declared, effect-verified replay baselines, reconcile tracking with supported `supabase migration repair --status applied`, read the remote ledger back, and lease the resulting evidence to the exact recovery PR head.
invariants: no pull_request trigger on the production baseline capture workflow
official supabase db dump and migration list only
exact-head force-with-lease before writing baseline evidence
fresh replay and parity remain independently required
no production schema/data DDL/DML mutation; only bounded supported migration-history tracking repair
repair set must equal the exact effect-verified replay baselines and remote readback must prove each repaired version
recovery lock may become REPAIRED_APPLIED_VERIFIED only after official remote migration-history dump proves exact version/name identities
root_cause: Migration-history parity had three replay-baseline files whose production effects were already verified, but their versions were absent from the remote migration ledger. Re-executing their SQL would be unsafe, direct writes to supabase_migrations are forbidden, and PR-controlled code must not receive production credentials.
prevention: Perform migration-history reconciliation only from trusted default-branch workflow code.
Require the pre-repair drift set to equal exactly 20260920101150, 20260920102450 and 20260925080500 with zero remote-only migrations.
Use only the supported Supabase CLI migration repair status-applied operation so no migration SQL is re-executed.
Require post-repair migration list drift to be zero before capturing or writing baseline evidence.
Advance the recovery lock to REPAIRED_APPLIED_VERIFIED only after official migration-history readback and exact-head lease checks.
